page.overview:
Who is Koth Barak?

Koth Barak was a male Human and a midshipman of the New Republic warship Adamantine. He was the first victim of the Death Seed plague in Meridian sector in 13 ABY though no one knew it at the time. He was found dead by Gunnery Sergeant Gallie Wover, another member of the ship's crew who would also die of the illness.
